title: get apihealth returns service status
description: Verify that GET /api/health returns a 200 response with fields ok, service, ai, evidence, and time indicating the current health and status of the service.

title: post apiauthregister creates new user with consent
description: Test POST /api/auth/register with valid email, password, name, role, and consent payload creates a new user, returns 201 with user object and csrfToken.

title: post apiauthlogin authenticates user and returns csrf token
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password returns 200 with user object and csrfToken.

title: post apiauthlogout logs out active session
description: Test POST /api/auth/logout with valid session cookie and matching CSRF token returns 200 with ok true indicating successful logout.

title: get apiauthsession returns current user session and csrf token
description: Verify GET /api/auth/session returns 200 with current authenticated user object and csrfToken.

title: get apimeconsents returns active user consents
description: Test GET /api/me/consents with valid authenticated session returns 200 with array of active consent records.

title: post apimeconsents updates user consent status
description: Test POST /api/me/consents with valid session and purpose/granted payload updates consent and returns 200 with updated consent object.

title: get apimeexport returns complete user data export
description: Verify GET /api/me/export with valid session returns 200 with user's complete data export in JSON format.

title: get apiproperties lists properties for user
description: Test GET /api/properties with valid session returns 200 with array of properties accessible to current landlord or tenant.

title: post apiproperties creates new property for landlord
description: Test POST /api/properties with valid landlord property details creates a new property and returns 201 with property object and optional warning.
